query:
MATCH (sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber IN ["38.201", "38.202", "38.211", "38.212", "38.213", "38.214", "38.215", "38.291"]
WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(target:Spec)
WHERE target.specNumber = specNumber
WITH specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(owner:Spec)
WHERE owner.specNumber = specNumber
RETURN specNumber, crCount, count(DISTINCT sec.sectionId) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, specNumber ASC
